plain: Native American tribes and Aboriginal Australian tribes have long dealt with contact with otherworldly beings, and they even have their own initiation ceremonies for it. The religion scholar Diana Pasulka tells Michels this, without naming a source, as a reason to talk to these peoples. If so, what is now called UFO contact would be something some cultures have known and ritualised for a long time.
